phases.objective: Replace inference from stale public runtime identity with bounded authenticated read-only evidence from Hostinger Node.js build history and failed-build logs, without creating builds, deploying, restarting, or exposing credentials.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted release operator and GitHub Actions
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Node.js Build Evidence workflow contract test or trusted workflow dispatch from main
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A structured JSON and Markdown artifact classifies whether a Hostinger Node.js build exists after the protected Production merge, identifies its state and bounded source provenance when exposed, and includes a redacted log excerpt only for the newest failed build.
steps: Validate the Hostinger account username, fixed auth.mad4b.com domain, exact protected Production SHA, and Production merge timestamp.
Build the official Hostinger Node.js build-list URL using encoded path parameters.
Authenticate with HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN without returning the token in logs or artifacts.
Perform an authenticated GET request for page one of Node.js builds.
Normalize collection response variants and sort builds by provider timestamps.
Select the newest build created or updated after the protected Production merge.
Classify pending, running, failed, completed exact-SHA, completed other-SHA, completed source-unverified, and no-build outcomes.
When the newest build failed, perform one authenticated GET for its logs and retain only a bounded redacted excerpt.
Upload the structured artifact before enforcing the evidence decision.
assertions: The API base URL is exactly https://developers.hostinger.com.
The live domain is restricted to auth.mad4b.com.
The Authorization bearer token is never returned by the report, Markdown, console result, or failure messages.
Provider responses and failed-build logs are bounded before persistence.
A completed build is not treated as exact-SHA proof unless the provider response exposes the expected Production SHA.
Completed builds without source SHA are classified as partial rather than passed.
No build, deploy, restart, provider mutation, repository mutation, SQL execution, migration Apply, database mutation, or external send occurs.

Add bounded pagination, rate-limit retry guidance, correlation-ID preservation, and multi-page build discovery without increasing provider write authority.
Validate the reporter against an authorized non-production Hostinger Node.js application before using any future provider mutation action.
Make authenticated Hostinger build-history evidence a required companion to public runtime parity after every protected Production promotion.
